## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasStepper> CreateStepper( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasStepper> CreateStepperWizard( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, const std::vector<std::string>& titles);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasStepper> CreateVerticalStepper( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasStepper(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasStepper(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasStepper(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onStepChanged` | `std::function<void(int)> onStepChanged` | new current step |
| `onStepClicked` | `std::function<void(int)> onStepClicked` | a step marker/label was clicked |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### enum `StepperOrientation`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Horizontal` | markers left-to-right, labels below |
| `Vertical` | markers top-to-bottom, labels to the right |

### enum `StepMarkerStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NumberedCircle` | circle with the step number (check when completed) |
| `IconCheck` | check / number / error glyph per state |
| `Dot` | minimal filled dot (no number) |
| `Custom` | user-supplied vector/image icon per step |

### enum `StepperNavigation`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Linear` | only completed/active steps are clickable (go back); advance via NextStep() |
| `NonLinear` | any enabled step is clickable |
| `Display` | not interactive — a pure progress indicator |

### enum `StepState`

Derived (or explicitly forced) state of a single step.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Upcoming` |  |
| `Active` |  |
| `Completed` |  |
| `Error` |  |
| `Disabled` |  |
